content.text: Digital creators in Africa face significant barriers when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-what-actually-how-works-2|selling]] their products online. Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators with limited options. However, with the right infrastructure, you can launch your digital product store today, without relying on these platforms. By leveraging blockchain payments and cloud infrastructure, it's possible to eliminate geographic restrictions and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-what-nobody-2|COREMERCH guide to start]]-selling-digital-products-crypto-step-step-11|How to]] generating revenue almost immediately. This guide outlines the steps to get your digital products live before the end of the day, ensuring you can access global markets.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

The first step is to set up your digital storefront using free hosting. Platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages allow you to create a website at no cost. Integrate backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle your transactions securely. This infrastructure provides the backbone for your store and allows for immediate deployment. Use NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments without the restrictions of traditional banking systems. By focusing on these steps, you can have your store operational within hours.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To establish a functional digital product store, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack for just $97. This includes GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend processing. You can load three products and receive 30 days of support to help you navigate through any initial challenges. Additionally, NOWPayments will enable you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing a seamless transaction experience. This stack is designed for those who need a quick and effective solution to sell digital products without the need for traditional payment processors.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Avoid getting bogged down by unnecessary features or complex integrations at this stage. Focus on the essentials: setting up your storefront, integrating payment processing, and uploading your products. Many creators spend time perfecting their websites when they should prioritize getting transactions flowing. Once your store is operational, you can refine your branding and user experience based on real customer feedback. The aim is to get your first sales rolling in without delay.
Launch your digital store today without traditional banking barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once your store is set up, it’s time to make your first sale. Promote your digital products through social media, leveraging platforms popular in your region. Share direct links to your products and highlight the ease of cryptocurrency payments. With USDT on Tron settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, this is an attractive option for international buyers. Ensure you test the payment process yourself first to confirm everything operates smoothly.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, your goal should be to finalize your product listings and drive traffic to your store. Create engaging content that explains the benefits of your products and how to purchase them using crypto. Utilize Binance P2P to convert local currencies like naira or cedis into USDT for easy transactions. Make sure to share your store link on various platforms and reach out to potential customers directly.

This allows transactions without reliance on traditional platforms, enabling seamless acceptance of cryptocurrencies. By using infrastructure like Cloudflare and Google Apps, creators can launch their stores without geographical restrictions, ensuring they reach a global audience effectively.
